apply_page.statutory_annual_info: BCEA §20: Matšatši a mošomo a {minDays} a maikhutšo a ngwaga ka moikhutšo. {accrual}
apply_page.statutory_sick_info: BCEA §23: Maikhutšo a bolwetši a lekantšwe ka moikhutšo wa nywaga e 3 (matšatši a 36 bakeng sa beke ya matšatši a 5). Setifikeiti sa kalafo se a nyakega ka morago ga matšatši a 2 a a latelanago, ka Mošupologo/Labohlano, goba ge palomoka ya beke tše 8 tše di dikologago e feta matšatši a 6.
apply_page.statutory_frl_info: BCEA §27: Matšatši a {cap} a Maikhutšo a Boikarabelo bja Lapa ka moikhutšo wa ngwaga wa maikhutšo. Ditiragalo tše di swanetšego: matswalo a ngwana, bolwetši bja ngwana, lehu la seloko sa lapa.
apply_page.statutory_maternity_info: BCEA §25: Dikgwedi tše 4 tše di latelanago tša maikhutšo a bobotsedi a sa lefelwego. Sedibelo sa maikhutšo a bobotsedi se tumeletšwego se swanetše go ngwadišwa go HR pele ga go kgopela.
apply_page.statutory_parental_info: Van Wyk 2025 / BCEA §25A: Maikhutšo a bobotsedi a nyaka sedibelo se se tumeletšwego se ngwadišitšwego ke HR. Diiri tše abetšwego di ngwathwa go tšwa sedibelong; melao ya maikhutšo a go sepelelana e a šoma.
apply_page.statutory_study_info: Maikhutšo a thuto a laolwa ke tumelelo ya bolaodi le ditokumente tša thekgo (bohlatse bja ngwadišo / tsebišo ya tlhahlobo).
apply_page.statutory_unpaid_info: Maikhutšo a sa lefelwego ga a na go lefelwa. Tumelelo e laolwa ke hlogo ya kgoro ya gago le HR.

apply_page.parental_pool_notice: Sedibelo sa maikhutšo a bobotsedi se se tumeletšwego se swanetše go ngwadišwa ke HR pele kgopelo ye e ka dirwa. Ikgokaganye le HR ge o sešo wa hlama se.

social.title: Kabo ya Setšhaba
social.subtitle: Kgokaganya marangrang a gago, kgetha gore dihlogo tse phatlaladitswego di tsebiswa kae, gomme o bone tsebiso ye nngwe le ye nngwe yeo e rometswego
social.no_accounts: Ga go na diakhaonto tše di kgokagantšwego go fihla bjale. Kgokaganya Facebook, X, LinkedIn goba Instagram go posta ka bowena.
social.token_hint: Thoukhene ya API ya go tsena bakeng sa akhaonto ye (e bolokilwe ka ntlha ya sephiri)
social.one_click_hint: Diplatifomo tšeo di nago le seswantšho sa legadima di kgokagana ka go klika gatee — fo tsena o dumelele. Tše dingwe di go dumelela go kgomaretša token ya phihlelelo.
social.prefer_oneclick: Sethala se se thekga kgokagano ya go tobetša gatee — se šišinywa bakeng sa bašomiši ba bantši.
social.account_name_hint: Leina lefe goba lefe la go lemoga akhaonto ye, e.g. "Mkhaya Facebook Page"
social.website_conn_hint: Ke weposaete efe yeo akhaonto ye e phatlalatšago bakeng sa yona (goba diweposaete ka moka)

guides.facebook:
1. Eya go akhaonto ya gago ya Meta Business / Developers.
2. Hlama Page Access Token ka tumelelo ya pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopiša Page ID ya gago (ka gare ga About/Settings ya Page) le token ka mo tlase.
guides.x:
1. Eya go developer.x.com o bule app ya gago.
2. Hlama OAuth 2.0 user access token ka tweet.write scope.
3. Kgomaretša token ka mo tlase.
guides.linkedin:
1. Eya go linkedin.com/developers o bule app ya gago.
2. Hwetša access token ka w_member_social scope.
3. Kgomaretša author URN ya gago (urn:li:person:XXXX) le token ka mo tlase.
guides.instagram:
1. Instagram ya gago e swanetše go ba akhaonto ya Business ye e kgokagantšwego le Facebook Page.
2. Hwetša token ka tumelelo ya instagram_content_publish.
3. Kgomaretša Instagram user ID ya gago le token ka mo tlase.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Beakanya WhatsApp Cloud API ka gare ga Meta.
2. Kopiša access token ya gago ya sa ruri.
3. Kgomaretša nomoro ya mogala ya moamogedi (le khoutu ya naga) le token ka mo tlase.

ext_hint.facebook: Page ID ya gago ya Facebook (dinomoro fela)
ext_hint.instagram: User ID ya akhaonto ya gago ya Instagram Business
ext_hint.whatsapp: Nomoro ya mogala ya moamogedi le khoutu ya naga, e.g. 27821234567

social.log_subtitle: Tsebiso ye nngwe le ye nngwe, ye mpsha pele. Yeo e gannwego e ka romelwa gape — hlogo ye swanago ga e dumelelwe go phatlaladitswa gabedi, ka fao ye ke tsela ya go boa.

Facebook: Products → Facebook Login → Settings → Valid OAuth Redirect URIs
LinkedIn: Auth → OAuth 2.0 settings → Authorized redirect URLs
Di swanetse go swana tlhaka ka tlhaka — ga go slash mafelelong, ga go www.

skills_levy.what_this_is: Mogolo o lefa lekgetho la tlhabollo ya bokgoni kgwedi le kgwedi le EMP201. Karolo e tee ya tše hlano ya lona e ka bušetšwa bjalo ka thušo yeo e gapeletšago, eupša feela ke mothwadi yo a romelago Leano la Bokgoni la Lefelo la Mošomo pele ga 30 Aporele.
skills_levy.exempt: Ka fase ga mollwane wa R500 000 — o lokologile
skills_levy.all_good: Ga go selo seo se šetšego ngwageng wo wa lekgetho.
skills_levy.record_help: Letšatši la mafelelo la ngwaga wo wa lekgetho ke {deadline}. Seo o se kgopetšego se balwa go tšwa lekgethong leo le lefilwego ka nnete, ga se ngwalwe ka seatla.

councils.description: Makgetho a lekgotla, ditekanyo tšeo a balwago ka tšona, le gore a akaretša bašomi bafe.
councils.how_it_works: Lekgetho le ntšhwa mogolong o mongwe le o mongwe wa bašomi bao lekgotla le ba akaretšago, gomme le lefelwa le moneelo wa mothwadi. Boleloko ke ka motho ka o tee: mothwadi o tee gantši o na le bašomi bao ba akaretšwago le bao ba sa akaretšwego mogolong o tee.
councils.beneficiary_hint: Letlole leo le lego skrining sa ditefo tša batho ba bangwe leo le amogelago lekgetho le.
councils.no_beneficiary: Ga go letlole leo le kgokagantšhitšwego, ka gona lekgetho le ntšhwa eupša ga go selo seo se rulaganyago go le lefa.
councils.no_rate: Ga go tekanyo yeo e ngwadilwego — ga go selo seo se tla ntšhwago.
councils.fixed_line: {employee} go mošomi, {employer} go mothwadi, nako ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
councils.percent_line: {employee}% go mošomi le {employer}% go mothwadi, e beilwe mollwane wa {ceiling}.
councils.all_rates: Sephetho se sengwe le se sengwe
councils.nobody_covered: Ga go motho yo a akaretšwago ke lekgotla le gabjale.
councils.rate_help: Sephetho seo se šomago se tswalelwa letšatši pele se se thoma, ka gona ga go letšatši leo le akaretšwago gabedi.
councils.ceiling_hint: Makgotla a beya mollwane makgethong a diperesente. Ntle le wona yo a amogelago tšhelete ye ntši o ntšhwa go feta tekanyo kgwedi le kgwedi.
councils.source_hint: Mo palo e tšwago, mohl. tsebišo ya gazette ya lekgotla
councils.members_help: Feela bašomi bao lekgotla le le ba akaretšago. Go oketša bohle go fošagetše bjalo ka go se oketše motho.
councils.none_yet: Ga go makgotla ao a beilwego.

report_sources.projects: Go tšwa diprojekeng ka bo tšona — Diprojeke, gomme o bule ye nngwe.
report_sources.work: Go tšwa letlakaleng la Mošomo la projeke ye nngwe le ye nngwe, moo sebopego le mešomo ya sona di agwago gona.
report_sources.dependencies: Go tšwa go Mošomo → Kgokaganya mešomo, moo mošomo o tee o dirwago gore o emele o mongwe.

report_sources.evidence: Go tšwa rejisetareng ya bohlatse — sedirišwa sa nageng, baromedi ba dimodule le API ya go tsenya.
report_sources.figures: E tšwa go bohlatse. Lebelela letlakala la Dipalo la projeke gore o hwetše melao ye e lego ka morago ga palo ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
report_sources.timesheets: Go tšwa go Kabo → Nako projekeng. Oketša batho pele go thebe ya Batho — diiri di begwa ka setho.
report_sources.assignments: Go tšwa go Mošomo, ka go fa setho mošomo, ka phesente ya kabo. Oketša batho pele go Kabo → Batho.
report_sources.labour: Diiri tše amogetšwego × tefo. Beakanya tefo ge o bega diiri go Kabo → Nako; ke diiri tše amogetšwego fela tšeo di balwago.
report_sources.costs: Go tšwa go Kabo → Ditshenyagalelo projekeng, moo dithoto, metšhene le bakonteraka ba ka tlase di begwago gona. Ke tše amogetšwego le tše lefilwego fela tše di balwago.
report_sources.members: Go tšwa go Kabo → Batho projekeng.
report_sources.approvals: Di hlolwa ka boiketlo ge diiri goba ditshenyagalelo di romelwa. Gore ke mang yo a dirago sephetho go beelwa go Setup → Tsamaišo ya ditumelelo.

site.no_diary: Ga go na dipego tša pukwana gabjale.
site.no_diary_hint: Pukwana ya lefelo la mošomo ke tokumente ya mathomo yeo motho a e nyakago ge tiego e ganetšanwa.
site.delays_hint: Selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo se emišitšego goba se diegišitšego mošomo. Bja ke bohlatse bja koketšo ya nako.
site.snags_sub: Dilo tša lenaneo la tokišo, mafokodi le go se latele melao
site.no_snags: Ga go na selo seo se šetšego.
site.closure_note: Ka moo go lokišitšwego ka gona
site.close_needs_evidence: Go se latele melao goba bofokodi bjo bogolo bo swanetše go bolela ka moo bo lokišitšwego ka gona — lenaneo leo le tletšego ditswalelo tše di se nago selo ga le kgone go emelwa ge mošomo o fetišwa.
site.kind_hint: Phošo ke ya ponalo; NCR ke go palelwa ga boleng bjo bo rulagantšwego bjo bo swanetšego go tswalelwa ka bohlatse.
site.boq_sub: Theko yeo mošomo o beilwego go yona, le seo se lekantšwego kgahlanong le yona
site.no_boq: Ga go na dilo tša lenaneo gabjale.
site.measured_to_date: Seo se lekantšwego go fihla bjale
site.measure_hint: Seo se kopantšwego, e sego sa nako ye. Lenaneo ke la {quantity} {unit}.
site.item_no_hint: Tšhupetšo lenaneong leo le nago le ditheko, mohl. 1.2.3
site.claims_sub: Mošomo wo o lekantšwego go fihla bjale, go tlošitšwe tšhelete yeo e bolokilwego, go tlošitšwe seo se šetšego se netefaditšwe
site.draft_claim_sub: Palo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e balwa go tšwa lenaneong le setifikeiting sa mafelelo — fetoša fela seo o swanetšego go se fetoša.
site.no_claims_hint: Lekanya lenaneo pele; kgopelo e lokišwa go tšwa go lona.
site.confirm_certify_body: Kgopelo #{number} ya {amount} e ba tšhelete yeo e kolotwago, gomme e ngwalwa ditshenyagalelong tša protsheke. Se se ka se phumolwe.
site.col_net_due: Seo se šetšego seo se kolotwago
site.work_to_date: Mošomo wo o lekantšwego go fihla bjale
site.work_to_date_hint: E tšea boleng bjo bo lekantšwego bja lenaneo ka boyona.
site.retention_hint: Gantši ke 10%, e fokotšega go ba seripagare ge mošomo o feditšwe ka tirišo.
site.milestone_claim_hint: Fela go dikonteraka tšeo di lefago ka megato go e na le go lefa ka tekanyo.
site.retention_note: E lokollwa ge mošomo o feditšwe ka tirišo le ka mafelelo

resources.title: Diphapoši, dilaesense le metšhene
resources.subtitle: Dilo tšeo protsheke e di beelago tšeo go se nago mojule o mongwe wo o nago le lenaneo la tšona. Dithoto le dikoloi di dula dimojuleng tša tšona gomme di kgokagantšwe go tšwa protshekeng.
resources.confirm_remove_named: {name} e ka se sa fiwa. Diprotsheke tšeo di šetšego di e šomiša di boloka pego ya tšona.
resources.none: Ga go na selo mo gabjale.
resources.name: Leina
resources.identifier_hint: Nomoro ya phapoši, goba tšhupetšo ya laesense.
resources.capacity_hint: Ditulo, goba dilaesense tšeo di šomišwago ka nako e tee.
resources.available_to_hint: Go laesense, le ke letšatši la go fela.

purchases.note: Se se dira kgopelo ya theko go Kgoro ya Ditheko, e swailwe ka khoutu ya protsheke ye. Ditlhahlobo tša bona tša ditshenyagalelo le tsela ya tumelelo di a šoma — ga go selo seo se odarwago pele ba dumela.
purchases.justification_hint: Ke ka lebaka la eng protsheke e e nyakago. Se ke seo yo a amogelago a se balago pele.
purchases.unavailable: Ditheko di kgopelwa mojuleng wa Ditheko, wo o sa tsentšhwago lefelong le la mošomo.

announcements.title: Ditsebišo
announcements.subtitle: Go botša sehlopha ka moka sa protsheke selo, ka pego ya gore ke mang yo a se bonego.
announcements.none: Ga go na selo seo se rometšwego.
announcements.audience_hint: Protsheke e tee, goba bohle bao ba dirago mošomo wa protsheke.
announcements.body: Seo o nyakago ba se tsebe
announcements.urgent_warning: Ditsebišo tše di potlakilego di romelwa gape ka SMS go bohle protshekeng, gomme di balwa go tšwa kabelong ya gago ya SMS ya kgwedi.
announcements.expires_at: Emiša go e bontšha ka morago ga
announcements.expires_hint: E tlogele e se na selo gore e dule gona go fihlela o e tloša.
announcements.require_ack: Kgopela batho gore ba e netefatše
announcements.require_ack_hint: Šomiša se go selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo se nago le seabe polokegong goba konterakeng — e sego ditsebišong tše di tlwaelegilego.
announcements.ack_pending_title: {count} ye e letetšego netefatšo ya gago
announcements.ack_pending_body: Go na le motho yo a swanetšego go tseba gore o di badile.
announcements.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” e a tlošwa. Pego ya bao ba e bonego e a bolokwa.
announcements.mail_ack_required: Hle bula tsebišo gomme o netefatše gore o e badile.

registers.title: Dikotsi, mathata le diphetogo
registers.subtitle: Seo se ka sepelago gampe, seo se šetšego se sepetše gampe, le seo go kgopelwago gore se fetoge.
registers.risks_sub: Seo se sešogo se direge — le seo re ikemišeditšego go se dira ka sona
registers.issues_sub: Seo se diregilego, le ka moo se lokišitšwego ka gona
registers.changes_sub: Dikgopelo tša go fetola motheo, ka khuetšo ya tšona e ngwadilwe pele ga sephetho
registers.change_sub: Ngwala khuetšo pele ga sephetho — ke seo se dirago gore sephetho se be le tlhalošo.
registers.no_risks_hint: Projeke yeo e se nago dikotsi tše ngwadilwego ga se projeke yeo e se nago kotsi.
registers.no_issues: Ga go selo se se šetšego.
registers.no_changes_hint: Go fetola leano ka ntle ga lona ga go tlogele selo sa go bapetša phapano le sona.
registers.stat_reviews_due: Ditlhahlobo tše di fetilwego ke nako
registers.strategy_hint: Go efoga go tloša sebaki; go fetišetša go e fetišetša go yo mongwe, gantši ka konteraka goba ka inšorentshe.
registers.kind_hint: Tiragalo e swanetše go ngwala sebaki sa yona sa motheo pele e ka tswalelwa.
registers.field_mitigation: Seo re se dirago ka yona
registers.mitigation_hint: Kgato yeo e tšewago bjale gore e se ke ya direga gabonolo goba e se ke ya ba befe gakaakaa.
registers.field_contingency: Seo re tlago se dira ge e direga le ge go le bjalo
registers.contingency_hint: Leano leo o boelago go lona. Go le ngwala bjale go theko ye tlase go phala go le ngwala ka nako yeo.
registers.review_hint: Kotsi yeo go se nago yo a e hlahlobago ke kotsi yeo e se nago mong.
registers.field_closure_note: Ke ka lebaka la eng e tswalelwa
registers.closure_hint: E fetile, e laotšwe, goba e amogetšwe — bolela gore ke efe.
registers.task_hint: Ga go gapeletšwe. E tswalanya bothata le mošomo wo bo o amago.
registers.field_resolution: Ka moo bo rarollotšwego ka gona
registers.corrective_hint: Seo se dirilwego go lokiša seemo se.
registers.preventative_hint: Seo se thibelago gore bo direge gape.
registers.root_cause_required: Ye ke tiragalo goba bothata bja bohlokwa, ka gona sebaki sa motheo se swanetše go ngwalwa pele bo tswalelwa.
registers.field_reason: Ke ka lebaka la eng e kgopelwa
registers.reason_hint: Ke seo yo a amogelago a se balago pele.
registers.impact_note: Bolela seo e se dirago bopharing, ditshenyagalelong, nakong le bolengong. Tlogela lepokisi le se na selo ge o sa tsebe ka nnete — 0 yeo o sa e rego selo e fokotša phetogo feela ge yo mongwe a e amogela.
registers.impact_days_hint: Palo ye tlase ga lefeela e kgauswiša letšatši.
registers.field_impact_risk: Dikotsi tše mpsha goba tše di fetotšwego
registers.realise_note: Kotsi e dula lenaneong bjalo ka ye e diregilego, mola bothata bjo bofsa bo šupa morago go yona — kgokagano yeo ke bohlatse bja gore go be go na le yo a e bonego e etla.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} e ya go mang le mang yo a amogelago diphetogo projekeng ye. O ka se kgone go e fetola ge e sa le go bonwa.
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} e a dirišwa gomme go tšewa motheo, gore khuetšo ya yona nakong e kgone go elwa ka morago.
registers.close_needs_note: Bolela gore ke ka lebaka la eng kotsi e tswalelwa.
registers.needs_root_cause: Tiragalo goba bothata bja bohlokwa bo swanetše go ngwala sebaki sa bjona sa motheo.
registers.change_not_editable: Kgopelo yeo ya phetogo e go yo a amogelago.
registers.change_not_approved: Ke phetogo yeo e amogetšwego feela yeo e ka dirišwago.
registers.no_flow_auto: Ga go tsela ya tumelelo yeo e beetšwego dikgopelo tša phetogo lefelong le la mošomo, ka gona e ngwadilwe bjalo ka ye e amogetšwego.

portfolio.title: Sephuthelwana
portfolio.subtitle: Mananeo le diprojeke, le seo di se dirišago.
portfolio.portfolio_hint: Sehlopha sa mananeo le diprojeke tšeo di phadišanago ka tšhelete ye e swanago.
portfolio.programme_hint: Sehlopha sa diprojeke tšeo di abago sephetho se tee mmogo.
portfolio.empty_title: Ga go selo se kopantšwego go fihla bjale
portfolio.empty_body: Lenaneo ke sehlopha sa diprojeke tšeo di abago sephetho se tee — sepetlele: kago, IT le bašomi. Portfolio ke sehlopha sa mananeo le diprojeke tšeo di phadišanago ka tšhelete ye e swanago. Ka bobedi ga di gapeletšwe: ge o dira mešomo ye e sa amanego, ga o hloke le e tee.
portfolio.no_projects: Ga go diprojeke lenaneong le go fihla bjale.
portfolio.unassigned_sub: Di bontšhitšwe gore palomoka yeo e lego ka godimo e se ke ya di hlokomologa ka setu.
portfolio.budget_hint: Seo portfolio ye e ka se dirišago. Ka ntle ga sona ga go selo sa go bapetša le sona.
portfolio.outcome_hint: Polelo e tee. Lenaneo leo le se nago sephetho se tee ke portfolio ka leina le lengwe.
portfolio.assign_note: Projeke yeo e lego lenaneong e tšea portfolio ya lenaneo leo ka boyona — dikarabo tše pedi go “ke portfolio efe” ke ka moo palomoka e sa lekanego ka gona.

templates.title: Ditemplete tša projeke
templates.subtitle: Moo projeke ye mpsha e ka thomago gona, gore dikarolo tšeo batho ba di lebalago di be gona.
templates.capture_sub: Fetola mošomo wo o sepetšego gabotse gore o be mathomo a wo o latelago.
templates.capture_note: Matšatši a bolokwa bjalo ka dikgao go tšwa mathomong a projeke, e sego bjalo ka matšatši a khalendara — templete yeo e nago le matšatši a nnete e nepagetše ka letšatši leo e ngwadilwego ka lona gomme e fošagetše matšatši ka moka ao a latelago.
templates.none: Ga go ditemplete go fihla bjale.
templates.none_hint: Tšea projeke yeo e sepetšego gabotse, gomme wo o latelago o thome go yona.
templates.sub_type_hint: Dintlo, ditsela, ERP, lesolo — le ge batho ba e bitša bjang.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} e ka se sa fiwa. Diprojeke tšeo di dirilwego go yona ga di amege.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} ke templete yeo e romilwego, ka gona e fihlwa go e na le go e phumola — go e phumola go be go tla boa mpshafatšong ye e latelago.
templates.start_from_sub: Projeke ye ga e sešo ya ba le leano, ka gona le ka bewa godimo ga yona.

gates.title: Dikgoro tša dikgato
gates.subtitle: Seo se swanetšego go ba therešo pele projeke ye e tšwela pele.
gates.field_criteria: Seo se swanetšego go ba therešo
gates.criteria_hint: E ngwadilwe pele ga sephetho, e sego ka morago ga sona.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Kgoro yeo e tlogetšwego e swanetše go bolela gore ke ka lebaka la eng. Go fetiša e nngwe ka ntle ga lebaka ke pego yeo e phumolwago ka go nanya.
gates.none_hint: Ka ntle ga e tee, kgato ke leibole leo yo mongwe a le fetošago.

site_records.title: Dipego tša lefelo
site_records.subtitle: Ditaelo, diteko, ditlhahlobo le go fela — dipampiri tšeo kgopelo e bolelwago ka tšona.
site_records.instructions_sub: Seo o se boditšwego gore o se dire, neng, le ke mang
site_records.tests_sub: Disampole tšeo di tšerwego, le seo laporatori e se boletšego
site_records.inspections_sub: “Tlang le tlo lebelela pele ke khupetša”
site_records.completion_sub: Ka tirišo, ka dikarolo le ka mafelelo — ditifikeiti tšeo di lokollago tšhelete ye e bolokilwego
site_records.unconverted_title: Ditaelo tše {count} tšeo di kgopetšwego bjalo ka phetogo mola di se tša dirwa phetogo
site_records.unconverted_body: Ke moo tšhelete e lahlegago gona akhaonteng ya mafelelo. Di direng phetogo, goba le tloše kgopelo.
site_records.overdue_inspections: Ditlhahlobo tše {count} tšeo di kgopetšwego mola di sa ngwalwa
site_records.no_instructions_hint: “Le re boditše” ke ngangišano feela ge go na le tšhupetšo le letšatši.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: Go fetwa ke e tee ke seo se fetošago mošomo wo o feditšwego gore e be mošomo wo o swanetšego go bulwa gape.
site_records.no_completion: Ga go selo se netefaditšwego go fihla bjale.
site_records.no_completion_hint: Go fela ka tirišo go thoma paka ya mafokodi gomme gantši go lokolla seripa sa tšhelete ye e bolokilwego.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Moentšenere goba moemedi wa moreki — gantši e sego motho yo a nago le akhaonte mo.
site_records.field_instruction: Seo o se boditšwego gore o se dire
site_records.field_variation: Re e tšea bjalo ka phetogo
site_records.variation_hint: Ngwala pono ya gago bjale, e sego dikgweding tše di tlago ge akhaonte e ganetšanwa.
site_records.instruction_sub: E filwe pele yo mongwe a dumela gore ke phetogo — ke maikemišetšo a yona.
site_records.element_hint: “Setheo sa fase, sebaka 3” — go lekane go e hwetša gape.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Teko ye e paletšwego e bula go se latele melao ka boyona. Go tšhelwa mo go tšwago go yona go šetše go khupeditšwe, ka gona se ga se tlogelelwe keletšo ya yo mongwe.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Tlhahlobo yeo e nyakwago mantšiboa a ga se tsebišo.
site_records.inspection_sub: E kgopetšwe pele mošomo o khupetšwa.
site_records.field_retention_released: Tšhelete ye e bolokilwego ye e lokolotšwego
site_records.outstanding_hint: Lenaneo leo le tsenelelanago le setifikeiti. Go fela ka tirišo go newa mošomo o sa šetše — seo se tlwaelegile.
site_records.certify_sub: Se se lokolla tšhelete ye e bolokilwego gomme se thoma watšhe ya mafokodi.
site_records.certify_note: Go fela ka tirišo go gannwa ge bofokodi bja bohlokwa goba go se latele melao mo go bulegilego go le lenaneong — go netefatša godimo ga gona go lahla sebaka sa go go lokiša.
site_records.completion_blocked: Go na le bofokodi bja bohlokwa goba go se latele melao mo go bulegilego mo {count}. Go fela ka tirišo go ka se netefatšwe godimo ga gona.
site_records.already_a_variation: Taelo yeo e šetše e na le kgopelo ya phetogo.
site_records.failed_test_body: Sephetho {result} kgahlanong le seo se boletšwego sa {specified} {unit}.
site_records.retention_release_narration: Tšhelete yeo e swerwego e lokolotšwe

meetings.title: Dikopano
meetings.subtitle: Lenaneo, dipego, gore ke mang yo a bego a le gona, le seo se swanetšego go dirwa ka sona.
meetings.none: Ga go dikopano go fihla bjale.
meetings.project_hint: Ditiro di ka ba mešomo projekeng feela, ka gona kopano yeo e se nago yona e boloka ditiro tša yona dipegong.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Dikopano tše {count} tše di swerwego ka ntle ga gore dipego di abjwe
meetings.minutes_outstanding_body: Ke moo diphetho di nyamelago gona ka setu.
meetings.actions_n: ditiro tše {open} tše di bulegilego go tše {total}
meetings.agenda_hint: Le romelwa pele ga kopano; le ba sebopego sa dipego.
meetings.minutes_note: Diteng di ngwalwa le dipego ka boomo: “go dumelanwe kopanong ya lefelo” ke ngangišano feela ge pego e bolela gore ke mang yo a bego a le gona go dumelana le gona.
meetings.attendance: Ke mang yo a bego a le gona
meetings.actions_note: Ditiro di ba mešomo projekeng — tiro yeo e phelago dipegong feela ke tiro yeo go se nago yo a e dirago.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” le dipego tša yona di a tlošwa. Ditiro tšeo di šetšego di dirilwe di ba mešomo.

agile.title: Di-sprint le lenaneo leo le emetšego
agile.subtitle: Dipolelo ke mešomo ye e tlwaelegilego, ka gona poto, leano le matlakala a nako a sa šoma ka moka.
agile.ship: Swaya bjalo ka ye e lokolotšwego
agile.backlog_points: Dintlha tša lenaneo leo le emetšego
agile.backlog_sub: Dilo tšeo di sa beakanywago di ya fase — selo seo go se nago yo a se beago pele ga se sa bohlokwa go phala.
agile.epics_sub: Mošomo wo o fetago di-sprint. Kgatelopele ke dipolelo tša wona, e sego tekanyetšo ye e fapanego yeo e ka se dumelelanago le tšona.
agile.releases_sub: Seo se tšwilego, le seo se bego se le ka gare ga sona.
agile.no_active: Ga go sprint yeo e tšwelago pele.
agile.no_active_hint: Beakanya ye nngwe, tsenya dipolelo go yona, gomme o e thome.
agile.no_backlog: Ga go selo lenaneong leo le emetšego.
agile.no_goal: Ga go maikemišetšo ao a beilwego — sprint yeo e se nago wona ke lepokisi la nako feela.
agile.remaining_of: Dintlha tše {remaining} tše di šetšego go tše {committed}
agile.stories_done: Dipolelo tše {done} tše di feditšwego go tše {total}
agile.burndown: Kerafo ya go fela ga sprint
agile.goal_hint: Polelo e tee. Ge o sa kgone go e ngwala, sprint ga e na maikemišetšo.
agile.field_revision: Commit goba leswao leo le romilwego
agile.revision_hint: Ka ntle ga yona, “go be go na le eng mohuteng wo” ke go akanya dikgweding tše tshela tše di tlago.
agile.close_note: Dipolelo tšeo di sa fetšwago di boela lenaneong leo le emetšego, e sego pele go sprint ye e latelago — go di fetišetša ka bojona ke ka moo sprint ye e latelago e thomago e tletše pele yo mongwe a e beakanya.
agile.already_started: Sprint yeo e šetše e thomile.
agile.one_at_a_time: Sprint ye nngwe e šetše e tšwela pele projekeng ye. Tše pedi ka nako e tee di dira gore lebelo le kerafo ya go fela di se kwešišege.
agile.not_active: Ke sprint yeo e tšwelago pele feela yeo e ka tswalelwago.
agile.closed_note: {name} e tswaletšwe: dintlha tše {completed} di feditšwe go tše {committed}.

portal.title: Diprojeke tša gago
portal.subtitle: Seo se diregago mešomong ya gago, le seo se nyakago wena.
portal.empty_title: Ga go selo mo sa gago
portal.empty_body: Portal ye e bontšha diprojeke tšeo o kgokagantšwego le tšona bjalo ka moreki goba bjalo ka konteraka. Ge o šoma mo, diprojeke tša gago di ka fase ga Diprojeke.
portal.awaiting_title: Dilo tše {count} di emetše sephetho sa gago
portal.progress_note: Ye ke palo yeo e swanago le yeo sehlopha se abago se e bonago — ga e balwe ka thoko go wena.
portal.no_work: Ga go selo seo se filwego wena go fihla bjale.
portal.hours_this_month: Diiri tše {n} tše ngwadilwego kgweding ye
portal.time_sub: E feta tumelelong ye e swanago le ya letlakala la nako la mang le mang.
portal.snags: Diphošo tšeo di lego go wena
portal.claims_sub: Seo se netefaditšwego, le seo se sa lego go bonwa
portal.documents_sub: Ka moka mošomong wo tšeo o ka di bonago, le moo o ka re romelago selo
portal.no_documents: Ga go ditokumente go fihla bjale.
portal.rate_sub: Tekanyetšo e tee ka kgwedi — e ya thwii go sehlopha se se abago.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Go botega go thuša go phala go ba botho. Ga go yo a elwago ka se ka noši.
portal.rate_comment: Selo le ge e le sefe seo o nyakago go se bolela
portal.not_rated: Ga o sešo wa ela kgwedi ye.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Beakanya invoisi ya mošomo wa gago gomme o e romele go molaodi wa porojeke.
portal.new_invoice_sub: Setšhupo sa gago le nako yeo e akaretšwago.
portal.no_invoices: Ga o sešo o lefiše go porojeke ye.
portal.invoice_reference_hint: Bjalo ka ge e tšwelela go invoisi ya gago.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Oketša bonnyane mothalo o tee, goba kgokaganya invoisi ya gago, pele o e romela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: Invoisi ye e šetše e rometšwe gomme e ka se fetošwe.
portal.my_contracts_sub: Seo o šomago ka fase ga sona mošomong wo.

data_sources.title: Methopo ya tshedimošo
data_sources.subtitle: Methopo yeo khamphani ye e netefatšago bafani ka yona, seo mothopo o mongwe le o mongwe o ka se arabago, le ditlhahlobo tšeo go se nago motho yo a ka di arabago.
data_sources.automated_checks: Ditlhahlobo tšeo di nago le mothopo
data_sources.ledger_broken: Ketane ya bohlatse ga e sepelelane tsenyong ya {at} ({reason}). Tšea bohlatse bjo bo amegago bjalo ka bjo bo sa netefatšwago go fihlela go nyakišišwa.
data_sources.coverage_help: Tlhahlobo yengwe le yengwe yeo moduli wo o tsebago go e dira, le gore ke mang yo a e arabago lehono. Tlhahlobo yeo e se nago mothopo ga e fetwe — e begwa bjalo ka e sa hwetšagalego go fihlela motho a e dira gomme a bega seo a se hweditšego.
data_sources.manual_notice: Ditlhahlobo tše {count} ga di na mothopo wo o beakantšwego, ka gona motho o swanetše go di dira gomme a bege seo a se hweditšego.
data_sources.enable_label: Šomiša mothopo wo bakeng sa netefatšo
data_sources.enable_help: Ge se se tingwe, ditlhahlobo tšeo o bego o tla di araba di begwa bjalo ka tše di sa hwetšagalego go e na le gore di fete.
data_sources.credentials_help: Di šireleditšwe moo di bolokilwego gomme ga di ke di bušetšwa sekirineng se. Tsenya senotlelo go se fetoša; dinotlelo tšeo o sa di ngwalago gape di a bolokwa.
data_sources.enabled_checks: Ditlhahlobo tšeo mothopo wo o ka di arabago
data_sources.default_for_help: Moo methopo ye e fetago o tee e ka arabago tlhahlobo, wo o botšišwa pele.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Methopo yeo e lefelwago e ja tšhelete ka mogala o mongwe le o mongwe. Ge kabelo e fedile, ditlhahlobo di begwa bjalo ka tše di sa hwetšagalego go e na le go go lefiša.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Aterese yeo akhaonto ya gago ye e dumeletšwego e e fago bakeng sa tlhahlobo yengwe le yengwe. Mafelo a go tlatša a tlatšwa go tšwa go mofani.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Mafelo a go tlatša: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: E dula e hwetšagala. Motho o dira tlhahlobo mothopong gomme a bega seo a se hweditšego — e tsena pukung ye e swanago ya ditemošo, ka tsenyo ya bohlatse ye e swanago, e ngwadilwe leineng la gagwe.
data_sources.none_match: Ga go mothopo wo o sepelelanago le seo.

contractor.no_assessment: Ga go tshekatsheko ya SHEQ yeo e dirilwego ka lehlakoreng la kgwebo.
contractor.set_aside_note: Tokumente e dula ka faeleng bjalo ka bohlatse gomme e emiša go balwa ka tumelelanong. Šomiša se go lokiša letšatši la mafelelo leo le fošagetšego: go kgomaretša setifikeiti se se nepagetšego ga se lekane ka bo sona, ka gobane tlhahlobo e boloka tokumente efe goba efe yeo e felago mafelelong.
contractor.set_aside_hint: E ngwadilwe ka fase ga leina la gago. Mohlahlobi yo a botšišago gore ke ka lebaka la eng setifikeiti se emišitše go balwa o bala se.
contractor.pass_hint: Kgoro e hlahloba se gomme e hwetša karabo ye e phelago. Khoutu ga e swere selo ntle le tšhupetšo — ga go nomoro ya boitšhupo, ga go tshedimošo ya maphelo, ga go setifikeiti — ka fao e dula e bolokegile go gatiša, go tšea seswantšho le go fetišetša.
contractor.worker_site_hint: Tlogela e se na selo gore e latele lefelo la mokontraka.
contractor.pass_rotate_warning: Karata yeo e gatišitšwego e emiša go šoma ka pela gomme ye mpsha e swanetše go newa. Šomiša se ge karata e lahlegile goba motho a sepetše.
contractor.sites_hint: Tumelelo lefelong le lengwe ga se tumelelo lefelong le lengwe. Lefelo leo le thibelago mokontraka yo le a mo gana moo go sa šetšwe gore faele ya gagwe e reng mafelong a mangwe.
contractor.sites_none: Ga go mafelo a šomago ao go swanetšego go dirwa sephetho ka ona gabjale.
contractor.site_conditions_hint: A gatišwa sephethong sa heke ge karata ya bona e skenwa mo. Mohlala: ba felegetšwe ka mehla, mosegare fela.
contractor.site_reason_hint: Gobaneng lefelo le le dirile sephetho se.
contractor.site_reason_required: Go a nyakega. Thibelo yeo e se nago lebaka ga go yo a ka e tlošago.
contractor.site_valid_until_hint: Tlogela e se na selo ge tumelelo e sa fele.
contractor.site_block_warning: Se se ba gana lefelong le fela, gomme se ba gana go sa šetšwe gore boemo bja bona bja khamphani ka moka bo reng.

exposure.basis_hint: Gore palo e tšwa kae. Se sengwe le se sengwe ntle le palo yeo e tsentšwego ka seatla se dira gore dielo tša kgwedi di hlahlobje.
exposure.estimated_note: Dikgwedi tše {count} di ithekgile godimo ga palo yeo e tsentšwego ka seatla, ka fao dielo tša tšona ke dikakanyo.

mine.title: Moo ke Emego
mine.subtitle: Dithekethe tša ka, ditlhahlobo tša maphelo le go bala, bjalo ka ge tshepedišo e na le tšona
mine.no_record: Ga o na rekoto ya bašomi ga bjale, ka fao ga go selo ka faeleng seo se ka bontšhwago. Kgopela yo a hlomilego akhaonto ya gago gore a go oketše ka lenaneong la bašomi — go fihla moo, tshepedišo e ka se go botše gore o emile kae, gomme e ka se akanye.
mine.nothing_on_file: Ga go selo seo se ngwadilwego ka ga gago ga bjale, gomme ga go selo seo se nyakilwego go wena. Se ga se swane le go latela melao — se ra gore ga go selo seo se swanetšego go hlahlobja.
mine.all_current: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se lego ka faeleng se sa šoma.
mine.blocking: {count} ya dithekethe tša gago e feletše gomme e go thibela go šoma. O ka se newe tumelelo goba o saenelwe mošomo go fihlela e tsošološitšwe.

mine.induction_current: Tlhahlo ya gago ya lefelo e sa šoma.

move_hint.approve: E amogela faele bjalo ka ge e eme lehono. Tumelelo ke polelo ka ditokumente tšeo di lego ka gare ka letšatši le, ka fao e swere letšatši la mafelelo.
move_hint.suspend: E emiša tumelelo go šoma ntle le go gana faele. Batho ba bona ba ganwa kgorong go fihlela e bušetšwa.

Di šoma go mokonteraka yo mongwe le yo mongwe, ka gobane go di šomiša ka go se lekane ke ka fao tlhohlo kgorong e atlegago.

status_hint.EXPIRING: Ga go selo seo se hlaelago, eupša se sengwe se felelwa ke nako kgauswinyane.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Se sengwe seo se nyakwago ga se lokile. O kgethile gore o se gane go tsena ka baka la sona.
status_hint.BLOCKED: Boemo bjoo o thibelago ka bjona ga bo fihlelelwe.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Faele e go mohlahlobi. Ga go selo seo se hlaelago — ga go motho yo a e amogetšego.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Motho o emišitše faele ye. Seo se feta tšohle tšeo di baletšwego.

activities.title: Mešomo
activities.subtitle: Mošomo wo o dirwago lefelong, le gore mohuta o mongwe le o mongwe o nyaka eng gore o dumelelwe.
activities.name: Leina
activities.code_hint: Seo sebadi sa karata, tumelelo goba API e se romelago. Ditlhaka tše kgolo, go se be le sekgoba.
activities.requires_hint: Bohlatse bjo motho a swanetšego go ba le bjona. Mošomi yo a se nago bjo bongwe bja bjona o ganwa mošomong wo ka leina.
activities.requires_nothing: Ga go bokgoni bjo bo itšego
activities.who_can: Ke mang a ka o dirago
activities.high_risk_hint: E o swaya gore o lebelelwe gape. Heke e šoma ka seo mošomo o se nyakago, e sego ka se.
activities.permit_label: E nyaka tumelelo ya go šoma
activities.permit_hint: Tumelelo e swanetše go bulwa pele mošomo wo o thoma.
activities.retire_body: Ga o sa newa. Ditumelelo le ditiragalo tša go tsena tšeo di šetšego di ngwadilwe go wona di dula di balwa, gomme khoutu e ka šomišwa gape ka morago.
activities.no_match: Ga go mošomo wo o sepelelanago le seo.
activities.empty_body: Go fihlela mošomo o bolela seo o se nyakago, heke yeo e botšišwago gore “na motho yo a ka šoma godimo” ga e na selo seo e ka se hlahlobago gomme e dumelela bohle. Thoma ka lenaneo la Afrika Borwa leo le tlago gomme o fetoše seo o mongwe le o mongwe a se nyakago.
activities.install_missing: Oketša tše di tlwaelegilego tše di sego gona
activities.unstaffed: Mešomo ye {n} yeo go sego motho lefelong yo a swanelegago go yona gabjale. Goba ditifikeiti di swanetše go latelwa, goba tlhokego ga e nepagala.
activities.advisory_title: Bokgoni bjo bo sego gona bo a ngwalwa, ga bo ganwe
activities.advisory_body: Motho yo a hlokago bohlatse bjo bo nyakegago o a fetišwa gomme sekgoba se ngwalwa. Bulela “Bokgoni bjo bo sego gona bja mošomo” melaong ya go thibela bakontraka gore go ganwe go e na le fao.

attendance.subtitle: Ke mang yo a lego mo gonabjale, ke mang yo a tsenego a tšwa, le yo a sa kago a saena ge a tšwa.

attendance.nobody_on_site: Ga go yo a saennego a tsena.
attendance.no_movements: Ga go metšhikinyego ye e ngwadilwego.
attendance.no_site: Ga go lefelo leo le ngwadilwego
attendance.no_employer: Ga go mothwadi yo a ngwadilwego
attendance.search: Nyaka ka leina, mothwadi goba mošomo
attendance.when_hint: Tlogela e se na selo gore e be gonabjale. Nako ye e fetilego e a amogelwa, go ngwala lenaneo la pampiri; ye e tlago ga e amogelwe.
attendance.manual_note: E ngwalwa bjalo ka ye e tsentšwego ka seatla, gore tlhakišo e kgone go e fapanya le go skena. Sebadi seo se sa šomego ga se lebaka la go tlogela motho lenaneong.
attendance.everyone_in: Bohle lenaneong ba šetše ba tsene.
attendance.nobody_to_sign_out: Ga go yo a saennego a tsena.
attendance.monitor_only: O be a tla ganwa — heke ye e mokgweng wa go lebelela.

overrides.title: Tsenelelo ya nakwana
overrides.subtitle: Ke mang yo a dumeletšwego go feta heke yeo a bego a sa swanela go e feta, le ka tumelelo ya mang.
overrides.explainer: Tumelelo ye e kgethegilego e amogela motho yo faele ya gagwe e sego ka tlhabologong. E dirilwe gore go be bonolo go e fa — mokontraka yo a nago le mošomo eupša a se na tsela ya go tsena ke kamoo batho ba saenago ka leina la mogwera — gomme e bolokegile ka gobane ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ngwadilwe mo ka lebaka la yona, yo a e amogetšego le mafelelo a yona. Ga go ye e ka šomago nako ye e fetago matšatši a {days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Se se tsenya lefelong motho yo a bego a tla ganwa. Se ngwalwa ka leina la gago, le ka leina la yo a e amogetšego yo o mmolelago.
overrides.ending_soon: E fela ka tlase ga diiri tše 48
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Ditumelelo tše {n} di fela ka matšatši a mabedi. Di mpshafatše goba o di tlogele di fele — eupša dira sephetho, go e na le go di hwetša hekeng.
overrides.search: Nyaka ka motho, lebaka goba yo a amogetšego
overrides.show_closed: Bontšha tše di felilego le tše di gogilwego
overrides.none_open: Ga go selo seo se fetišitšwego gabjale.

intake.link_once: E bontšhitšwe gatee. E kopiše bjale — e ka se bontšhwe gape.
intake.withdraw_body: Kgopelo yeo e notletšwego e a tlošwa gore mokgopedi yo a kgone go romela gape. Go goga morago le kgopelo ye mpsha ka bobedi di dula mohlaleng wa tlhahlobo.
intake.opening_explainer: Dikgopelo ka moka tšeo di notletšwego di bulwa ka nako e tee, ke wena le hlatse. Go bula go direga gatee gomme go ka se dirwe gape.
intake.open_warning: Kgopelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe yeo e notletšwego e ba yeo e balegago motsotsong wo, gomme go ka se bušetšwe morago. Tšwela pele fela ge hlatse ya gago e le gona.

budgets_planning.import_notice: Methaladi e lekolwa e tee ka e tee. Mothaladi wo mobe o begwa ka nomoro ya mothaladi; ye e lokilego e sa tsenywa, bjalo ka dithaellwa.

budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Tekanyetšo ye nngwe le ye nngwe faeleng e hlolwa ngwageng wo.

budgets_planning.how_title: Ka fao go laiša go šomago ka gona
budgets_planning.how_1: Mothaladi wa mathomo o swanetše go ba wa hlogo. Maina a bapetšwa ntle le go lebelela ditlhaka tše dikgolo gomme dikgoba di ba di-underscore, ka fao “Allocated Amount” le “allocated_amount” ke kholomo e tee.
budgets_planning.how_2: Tatelano ya dikholomo ga e na taba, gomme dikholomo tšeo o sa di nyakego di ka tlogelwa faeleng ka mo go feletšego.
budgets_planning.how_3: Mothaladi o mongwe le o mongwe o lekolwa o nnoši. Mothaladi wo o palelwago o begwa ka nomoro ya wona faeleng gomme o tlodišwa — e šetšego e sa tsenywa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Tšohle di fihla bjalo ka dithaellwa. Ga go seo se šomago, gomme ga go seo se tsenago mothalading wa ditumelelo go fihlela motho a se romela.
budgets_planning.how_5: Boleng bjoo motsenyi a sa bo tsebego — legoro leo le ngwadilwego gampe goba mohuta wa tshenyagalelo — ga bo dire gore mothaladi o palelwe. Bo boela go ya ka mehla gomme bo ngwalwa bjalo ka temošo ka morago.
budgets_planning.how_6: Ga go seo se tlošwago ga bobedi. Go laiša faele ye e swanago gabedi go hlola ditekanyetšo gabedi, ka fao tsenya faele ye e lokišitšwego ngwageng wo mofsa goba o phumole dithaellwa pele.

budgets_planning.col_help_name: Leina la tekanyetšo, mohl. “Ditirelo tša Ofisi ye Kgolo”. Leina le se nago selo le dira gore mothaladi o palelwe.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Nomoro. Matshwao a tšhelete, dikgoba le dikaroganyi tša dikete di a tlošwa, ka fao “R 1 850 000,00” le “1850000” ka bobedi di a šoma. Selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo e sego nomoro se dira gore mothaladi o palelwe.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: E boela go opex ge e se na selo goba e sa tsebje.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: E swanetše go swana le le lengwe la maina a magoro ka fase. Leina leo le sa swanego le tlogela tekanyetšo e se na legoro gomme le tsoša temošo.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: E boela go ya kakaretšo ge e se na selo goba e sa tsebje.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Sengwalwa se se lokologilego seo se bitšago kgoro, protšeke goba senthara ya ditshenyagalelo, mohl. “Ofisi ye Kgolo”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Khoutu ya ditlhaka tše tharo bjalo ka ZAR. Se sengwe le se sengwe se a hlokomologwa gomme go šoma ya ka mehla ya khamphani.
budgets_planning.col_help_description: Sengwalwa se se lokologilego. Se bontšhwa letlakaleng la tekanyetšo.

settings_page.require_description: Nyaka tlhalošo go tsenyo ye nngwe le ye nngwe
settings_page.categories_hint: Seo tokumente e lego sona, go fapana le moo e tsentšwego. Dikarolo tšeo di agilwego ka gare di ka reiwa maina a maswa goba di tswalelwa eupša ga di tlošwe — dipego le melao ya polokelo di šupa go tšona.
settings_page.category_order_hint: Ye e ka fase e tšwelela pele
settings_page.category_protected: Dikarolo tšeo di agilwego ka gare ga di ka tlošwa. Go e na le moo e tswalele.
settings_page.category_in_use: E šomišwa ke ditokumente tše {n}. Go e na le moo e tswalele.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Lemoša batho pele tokumente e fela. Tlhwekišo e šoma mesong ye nngwe le ye nngwe gomme e romela kgopotšo ye nngwe le ye nngwe gatee.
settings_page.expiry_days: Lemoša matšatši a mantši ka tsela ye pele ga nako
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Kgotla enter ka morago ga palo ye nngwe le ye nngwe. 0 e ra ka letšatši la mafelelo ka bolona.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Mong wa tokumente o tsebišwa ka mehla. Dikarolo, e sego maina, gore kgopotšo e latele yo a swereng mošomo.
settings_page.retention_hint: How long documents in this category are kept. Leave the period empty for no schedule — nothing is ever destroyed automatically.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Shown beside the disposal queue, so a reviewer can see what the rule is for.
settings_page.sharing_warning: With this on, anybody holding a share link can open that document without signing in. Each link still expires, can be revoked, and is recorded.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Allow documents to be shared outside the organisation
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: The ceiling for any link. Somebody asking for longer gets this.
settings_page.ai_warning: With this on, the contents of a document are sent to the AI provider this platform is configured with, and count against the company’s monthly allowance.
settings_page.ai_enabled: Allow summaries and questions about documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential: Include confidential and legally held documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Off by default. These are the documents an organisation is least willing to hand to an outside service.
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Each share can still be changed individually. A watermark makes a leaked copy traceable; it does not prevent one.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: With this on, documents a reviewer has approved for disposal are deleted without further confirmation. Deletion here is recoverable — permanent destruction always stays with a person.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: How long an approval waits before it is acted on, so a mistake can be caught.
settings_page.automation_hint: What this category does on its own once the dates above have passed.
settings_page.archive_after_years_hint: Counted from the same date as the retention period
settings_page.auto_delete: Delete automatically once a disposal is approved
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Needs the company-wide setting as well. Documents under legal hold are never touched.

Šomiša fela ka tumelelo le ka go dumelelana le molao wa sephiri le wa bašomi.

employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Bulela go lebelela fela moo o dumeletšwego le moo go dumelelanago le molao wa sephiri le wa bašomi. Go lebelelwa tshedimošo ya SETŠHABA fela — e sego diakhaonto tša praebete. Dikutollo di a hlalošega, di na le kholofelo le mothopo, di hlompha nako ya polokelo ye e lego ka fase, di laolwa ka phihlelelo gomme di hlahlobja ka botlalo, gomme ga di ke di šomišetšwa diphetho tša mošomo tše di itiragalago.
